items.title: Heart Shaped Green Leaf
items.alt: One complete glossy deep green heart-shaped tropical leaf with a pronounced basal notch, smooth entire margin, fine arched veins and a long slender petiole, no holes or splits.
items.description: One complete glossy deep green heart-shaped tropical leaf with a pronounced basal notch, smooth entire margin, fine arched veins and a long slender petiole, no holes or splits.

items.title: Arrowhead Leaf
items.alt: One complete fresh green arrowhead-shaped leaf with a strong pointed central lobe and two distinct basal lobes, pale central midrib and clean smooth margins, full slender petiole.
items.description: One complete fresh green arrowhead-shaped leaf with a strong pointed central lobe and two distinct basal lobes, pale central midrib and clean smooth margins, full slender petiole.

items.title: Waxy Oval Leaf
items.alt: One thick glossy oval dark green rubber-plant-style leaf has a smooth entire margin, gently pointed tip, subtle reddish central midrib and short complete petiole, convincing waxy surface.
items.description: One thick glossy oval dark green rubber-plant-style leaf has a smooth entire margin, gently pointed tip, subtle reddish central midrib and short complete petiole, convincing waxy surface.

items.title: Asymmetric Patterned Leaf
items.alt: One complete asymmetrical begonia-style leaf has an off-center basal attachment, shallow toothed edge and a restrained silver-green patterned upper face with a small turned burgundy underside, no flowers.
items.description: One complete asymmetrical begonia-style leaf has an off-center basal attachment, shallow toothed edge and a restrained silver-green patterned upper face with a small turned burgundy underside, no flowers.

items.title: Pink and Green Heart Leaf
items.alt: One complete thin heart-shaped caladium-style leaf has a soft pink center, branching pale veins and a crisp green rim, full narrow petiole, natural form rather than an artificial heart icon.
items.description: One complete thin heart-shaped caladium-style leaf has a soft pink center, branching pale veins and a crisp green rim, full narrow petiole, natural form rather than an artificial heart icon.

items.title: Scalloped Patterned Leaves
items.alt: One short stem carries two opposite broad scalloped leaves with olive green edges and burgundy-pink inner markings, clear central veins and full leaf tips, natural coleus-like leaf structure.
